newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 597c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 597c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose five cents to 597 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece was dearer, with 19/20/25 micron up to 1.5 percent dearer, 21/23m one percent dearer, 22m 0.5 percent dearer and 24m two percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were generally unchanged, WI said.
In crossbreds, 26m was up to one percent dearer, 27/29/30/31 0.5 percent dearer and 28m unchanged.
In cardings, lambs were fully firm, locks slightly dearer and crutchings unchanged, it said.
WI said Japan, Western Europe and China were the principal buyers with support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 22,665 bales on offer, 5.5 percent was passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 37,800 bales to be offered.
